narrative: 用它来重新定向。一个卡座、一个吻、一次对峙都可以在不剪辑的情况下从正面转到侧面镜头（Profile）再到反打镜头（Reverse Angle），关系由视差重新书写。
主体可以保持不动；环绕的是这个世界。完整的360度环绕（360-Degree Orbit）是另一种承诺。
如果只需要一个新的视线方向，四分之一圆更简洁干净。如果房间里没有人的位置关系是重要的，那么弧形运镜就只是空洞的装饰。
how: 铺设弧形轨道或圆形推轨车，或者用斯坦尼康（Steadicam）沿恒定半径的曲线行走，摄影机始终朝向内侧。高度通常保持不变（眼位或胸位）。
前景的柱子、椅子或群演的错动速度应该比远处的墙壁更快。提示词：Arc around [Subject], camera traveling a curve while facing them, background sliding, a quarter or half orbit.
when: 在不剪辑的情况下改变轴线：一张桌子变成双人镜头（Two-Shot），揭示出背后站着谁。不要每一句台词都做180度弧形运镜；把这种曲线运动留给真正的权力关系变化。
vs: 左弧形运镜（Arc Left）和右弧形运镜（Arc Right）指明了运动的方向。360°环绕则完成整个圆周，通常用于在空间中审视一个身体。
摇镜头（Pan）只是从固定点上做偏航转动，因此背景不会产生同样的视差效果。
examples_film: 《好家伙》（Goodfellas）经常围绕卡座或桌子做弧形运镜，以呼应联盟关系的转变。《赎罪》（Atonement）在较长的镜头内使用曲线移动，在不剪辑的情况下重新定向一场戏。
把它们当作改变轴线的语法来借用，而不是照搬的画面。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是摇镜头。破绽在于：机身始终没有移动，只有云台在偏航转动，近处的物体不会产生错动。
修正方法：沿曲线移动，让镜头始终对准主体，让背景产生滑动错位。

faq.a: 弧形运镜镜头让摄影机沿圆周的一部分移动，同时始终面对主体，使背景产生滑动，让场景的轴线在不剪辑的情况下发生改变。
弧形运镜是四分之一或半圆的运动，用来改变轴线。360°环绕则完成整个圆周，把人物当作可以绕行审视的对象。
用它在不剪辑的情况下重新定向一场戏：一张桌子、一次对峙、揭示主体身后的情况。如果四分之一圆就够用，就不要做完整的旋转。

faq.q: How do I prompt Arc for AI image or video?
faq.a: 描述一段始终面对主体的曲线运动，并指明是四分之一还是半圆环绕。示例：Arc around [Subject], camera traveling a curve while facing them, background sliding.

narrative: Use it to reorient. A booth, a kiss, a standoff can turn from front to profile to reverse without a cut, so the relationship is rewritten by parallax.
The subject can stay put; the world is what orbits. A full 360 is a different promise.
If you only need a new eyeline, a quarter circle is cleaner. If nobody's position in the room matters, an arc is empty decoration.
how: Lay track or a circular dolly, or walk a steadicam on a curve of constant radius, camera facing inward. Height usually holds (eye or chest).
Foreground posts, chairs, or extras should shear faster than the far wall. Prompt: Arc around [Subject], camera traveling a curve while facing them, background sliding, a quarter or half orbit.
when: Change the axis without cutting: a table that becomes a two-shot, a reveal of who stands behind. Do not arc 180 degrees on every line; save the curve for a real change of power.
vs: Arc Left and Arc Right name the direction of travel. 360-Degree Orbit completes the circle and usually inspects a body in space.
A Pan only yaws from a fixed point, so the background does not parallax the same way.
examples_film: Goodfellas often arcs around a booth or a table as alliances shift. Atonement uses curved travel inside longer takes to reorient a scene without a cut.
Use them as grammar for changing axis, not as frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a pan. The tell: the camera body never moves, only the head yaws, and near objects do not shear.
The fix: travel a curve, keep the lens on the subject, and let the background slide.

faq.a: An arc shot travels the camera along part of a circle while facing the subject, so the background slides and the axis of the scene changes without a cut.
An arc is a quarter or half circle used to change axis. An orbit-360 completes the loop and treats the figure as something to walk around.
Use it to reorient a scene without cutting: a table, a standoff, a reveal behind the subject. Do not use a full spin when a quarter will do.

faq.q: How do I prompt Arc for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a curved travel that always faces the subject, and name a quarter or half orbit. Example: Arc around [Subject], camera traveling a curve while facing them, background sliding.
